newsitem.title: USA: Starrett principal holders may sell shares.
newsitem.headline: Starrett principal holders may sell shares.

text.p: Starrett Corp said Thursday that its principal stockholders are involved in discussions to sell their shares.
The talks have prompted the company to postpone its annual meeting to December 10 from October 15, it said.
The company said no agreement or terms have been reached and there are no assurances that such a sale will occur.
Starrett builds and sells single-family homes, high-rise apartments and office buildings.

Starrett Chief Financial Officer Lewis Weinfeld said the principal shareholders include Starrett Chairman Paul Milstein, who is representing a group of stockholders, director Henry Benach, and O. Aboodi.
Weinfeld said he did not know how many shares were held by those principal stockholders.
The company has 6.26 million shares outstanding, he said.
